components.name: API Gateway
components.purpose: Exposes RESTful endpoints for incoming order streams and inventory position queries.
components.rationale: Amazon API Gateway provides a fully managed, scalable API front door for webhooks and integration endpoints.
trade_offs: Requires token management and payload throttling controls.
components.security_considerations: Enforces TLS 1.3 encryption in transit and authenticates clients via API keys or Cognito tokens.

components.name: Enterprise Service Bus
components.purpose: Routes events asynchronously between integrations and manages dead-letter processing.
components.rationale: Amazon EventBridge offers native event routing and seamless integration with serverless compute without requiring self-managed clusters.
trade_offs: Event delivery ordering is not strictly guaranteed without explicit sequence numbers.
components.security_considerations: Uses IAM policy controls to restrict event publishing and subscription permissions.

components.name: Integration Microservices Execution
components.purpose: Executes business logic for order processing, inventory calculation, and data transformations.
components.rationale: AWS Lambda scales automatically with event volume and eliminates server management overhead.
trade_offs: Cold starts can introduce minor latency variations.
components.security_considerations: Runs inside private VPC subnets with least-privilege IAM execution roles.

components.name: SFTP File Storage and Integration
components.purpose: Exchanges batch files and dispatches securely with Nordkap Logistics over SFTP.
components.rationale: AWS Transfer Family provides fully managed SFTP endpoints directly backed by S3 storage.
trade_offs: Dependent on rigid third-party file batch drop schedules.
components.security_considerations: Restricts access using SSH keys and IP allowlisting.

components.name: Workflow Orchestrator
components.purpose: Orchestrates multi-step workflows including automated returns, nightly file reconciliation, and gap checks.
components.rationale: AWS Step Functions provides visual state machine management with built-in retry and backoff handling.
trade_offs: State transitions incur slight additional cost during massive batch runs.
components.security_considerations: Logs execution states securely with encrypted state data at rest.

components.name: Operational & Reconciliation Database
components.purpose: Stores payload history, sequence logs, ATP cache, and long-term reconciliation records.
components.rationale: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL provides high performance, auto-scaling storage, and ACID compliance for critical data.
trade_offs: Higher base cost compared to single-instance RDS.
components.security_considerations: Enforces KMS encryption at rest and SSL connections in transit.

components.name: Web Management Portal
components.purpose: Hosts the frontend interface for operators to view failed messages and trigger replays.
components.rationale: AWS Amplify Hosting provides fully managed static web hosting with integrated CDN and CI/CD.
trade_offs: Limited to static or single-page web app frameworks.
components.security_considerations: Protects web portal content via HTTPS and Cognito authentication.

components.name: Identity Provider
components.purpose: Authenticates operators accessing the web management portal.
components.rationale: Amazon Cognito delivers managed user directories with built-in multi-factor authentication support.
trade_offs: Custom token claim logic requires extra Lambda triggers.
components.security_considerations: Enforces strong password policies and MFA for all operator logins.

components.name: Key Management Service
components.purpose: Manages encryption keys for data at rest across databases, message payload stores, and file buckets.
components.rationale: AWS KMS provides centralized key control with seamless integration across AWS managed services.
trade_offs: API call limits must be monitored during heavy burst operations.
components.security_considerations: Implements strict key policies and key rotation enabled annually.

components.name: Observability Dashboard
components.purpose: Visualizes system performance metrics, error rates, and interface health for operation teams.
components.rationale: Amazon Managed Grafana satisfies customer requirement to integrate monitoring with Grafana.
trade_offs: Requires user license management via AWS IAM Identity Center.
components.security_considerations: Restricted via SSO and IAM role-based access control.

components.name: Virtual Network
components.purpose: Provides isolated network infrastructure with public and private subnets across availability zones.
components.rationale: Amazon VPC enables secure network isolation and controlled routing for backend resources.
trade_offs: Requires NAT Gateway provision for outbound internet calls.
components.security_considerations: Uses strict Security Groups, Network ACLs, and private NAT Gateways.

components.name: CI/CD Pipeline & Deployment Automation
components.purpose: Automates infrastructure provisioning and application code deployments across environments.
components.rationale: AWS CodePipeline integrates natively with AWS services to ensure reproducible deployments.
trade_offs: Build step execution times require tuning to keep pipeline fast.
components.security_considerations: Requires approval gates before promoting code changes into production.

components.name: Auto-scaling Container Platform
components.purpose: Dynamically scales serverless compute and database capacities during high peak volumes.
components.rationale: Application Auto Scaling ensures automatic scaling response to Black Friday load spikes.
trade_offs: Scaling limits must be set to avoid cloud expenditure spikes.
components.security_considerations: Applies upper scaling bounds to prevent unexpected resource exhaustion.

components.name: Automated Backup Service
components.purpose: Centralizes backup policies and retention management for databases and file stores.
components.rationale: AWS Backup automates cross-region backup replication and enforces 7-year retention compliance.
trade_offs: Long-term snapshot retention increases storage usage costs.
components.security_considerations: Protects backup vaults with write-once-read-many immutability settings.

environments.dev: Development environment provisioned with reduced capacity for feature integration and unit testing.
environments.test: Test environment replicating production topology for end-to-end integration and load testing.
environments.prod: Multi-AZ production environment deployed in eu-north-1 with automated failover and high availability.

deployment_runtime.text: Serverless execution runtime built on AWS Lambda and API Gateway inside private VPC subnets to ensure high scalability and zero server maintenance.

availability_scalability.text: Application Auto Scaling dynamically adjusts Lambda concurrent executions and Aurora database scaling to easily absorb Black Friday 6x peak loads.

backup_dr.text: AWS Backup automates daily snapshot backups of Aurora PostgreSQL with cross-region replication to eu-west-1, satisfying the 7-year audit retention requirement.

observability.text: Amazon Managed Grafana presents real-time interface health, error rates, and queue metrics to operators using metrics exported from CloudWatch.

security_controls.text: AWS KMS encrypts all operational databases and payload stores at rest, while Cognito and strict IAM policies enforce secure access in compliance with GDPR.
